name: esp32_wrover_dev
title: ESP32-WROVER-DEV
description: An ESP32-WROVER-E board with 8 MB PSRAM and a connector for a camera, sold with an OV2640: a CH340 USB bridge on micro-USB, a blue LED on GPIO 2, EN and BOOT buttons
notes: ESP32-WROVER-DEV on the board: a copy of Freenove's ESP32 WROVER CAM, whose pinout V1.6 is read. Freenove publishes no schematic of it.
The flash lines SD0 to SD3, CMD and CLK come out on the headers; GPIO 16 and 17 belong to the PSRAM of the module and do not.
LEDs: ON, green, the power; TX and RX on the lines of the USB bridge; IO2, blue.

mcu.notes: In an ESP32-WROVER-E. The ESP32 maps 4 MB of its 8 MB of PSRAM; himem reaches the rest.

power.name: 5V
power.why: From the micro-USB, also on the two contacts VCC.

en_side.type: 2.54 mm header, 20 pins, from the antenna end

gnd_side.type: 2.54 mm header, 20 pins, from the antenna end

front.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

pins.source: ESP32-Pinout_V1.6.pdf, FREENOVE ESP32 WROVER CAM Pinout, in Datasheet/ of github.com/Freenove/Freenove_ESP32_WROVER_Board, fetched 2026-11-07

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06
photo.notes: The silkscreen from the USB end: VCC VCC CMD SD3 SD2 13 GND 12 14 27 26 25 33 32 35 34 VN VP EN 3.3V on one side, GND CLK SD0 SD1 15 2 0 4 GND GND 5 18 19 GND 21 RX TX 22 23 GND on the other, as the pinout.

bench.by: a probe with esp32-camera 2.1.8, and Anton by eye
bench.notes: PSRAM of 8 MB found. On the pins of the pinout the camera answered as an OV2640 at SCCB 0x30 and gave an 800x600 JPEG with XCLK on GPIO 21 at 20 MHz. The blue LED is on while GPIO 2 is high. BOOT on IO0 (Anton).

chip.source: esptool on Anton's board: ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 rev 3.0, 4 MB flash of maker 0x5e; the port is a CH340, USB 1a86:7523
